title: State musical instrument; `auana; kahiko.
bodyText:
(a) The `ukulele is established and designated as the official `auana musical instrument of the State.

(b) The pahu is established and designated as the official kahiko musical instrument of the State.
bodyHtml:
[§5-10.5]  State musical instrument; `auana; kahiko.  (a)  The `ukulele is established and designated as the official `auana musical instrument of the State.

     (b)  The pahu is established and designated as the official kahiko musical instrument of the State. [L 2015, c 6, §2]
